app_tagline: Classes, passes and check-in — no server, no account.
connect_intro: Two devices connect directly — by QR code at the studio, or by pasted code from afar.
connect_waiting_answer: Paste the other device's reply code
sync_local_only: Recorded locally — has not reached the studio yet
fork_alarm_body: Two differently signed redemptions were found for the same position. Both records are listed below.
tickets_demo_notice: Sample data: these passes exercise the balance reducer. Real purchases arrive with milestone M4.
onboarding_intro: This device gets a passkey. It stays on the device and never leaves it — it is how this device is recognised later.
onboarding_user_id: Identifier (an email address is not required)
course_allow_dropin: Single sessions redeemable with a pass
join_success: Connected to “{studio}” — the programme is replicating.
guest_readonly: You are viewing this studio as a guest. Only the studio itself can make changes.
pending_devices_none: No device is waiting. Connect one first via “Connect”.
pending_device_hint: Name the device, not the person.
booking_local_only: Recorded locally — has not reached the studio yet
booking_full_refused: The class is full — there is no free place left to confirm.
checkin_no_ticket: This person has no valid pass.
checkin_refused_wrong_course: This pass is only valid for another class.
checkin_refused_outside: The pass is not valid for this date.
sync_alone: Not connected to anyone — showing only what this device knows
conflict_cancelled_after_redeem: Cancelled although {course} on {date} had already been checked in
conflict_body: Two devices decided independently. Nothing is resolved automatically — the facts are here, a person decides.
export_intro: Everything this device knows, as readable JSON — with the signed events, not just balances. With no server, the export is the backup.
second_device_body: This studio hangs on a single device. Lose it and the registry is gone, and nobody can approve or revoke anything again. A second owner device is not a convenience, it is the backup.
transfer_title: Move a pass to a new DID
transfer_intro: When a passkey is lost the DID goes with it. The balance that was paid for does not: it moves to the new device and the old card is voided.
transfer_void_failed: Moved, but {count} old pass(es) could not be voided — the balance now exists twice. Please try again.
transfer_same: The old and new DID are the same.
report_cash_intro: Takings by location and device. Reconciling needs no button: two devices merge their logs the moment they meet — this reports what is here afterwards.
report_none: No sales on this device yet.
report_overdraft_intro: More classes attended than paid for. That happens when two counters check in without a connection — detected, not prevented. Priced at the class rate actually paid.
counter_only_joined: This screen belongs to the studio’s devices. Yours belongs to this studio but is not approved as a counter — that is the owner’s decision.
counter_only_unpaired: This device does not belong to a studio yet. Connect it at the front desk first.
start_intro: There is no account and no login. This device creates a passkey — what it becomes is decided by the next step.
start_studio_body: Name the studio, add locations and courses, approve devices for the till and check-in.
start_student_body: Connect to the studio — by QR code at the front desk. Then book and see your own passes.
start_handbook_hint: How this is meant to work, and what it cannot do.
install_body: Installed, the app opens without browser chrome and works without the internet — on a front-desk tablet that is the difference between an app and a web page.
install_ios: In Safari: tap the Share icon, then “Add to Home Screen”.
